name: Discover it Cash Back Credit Card

localized_names.en: Discover it Cash Back Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers; 17.49% to 26.49% variable APR after that. Cash Advance APR: 28.49% variable. Cash advance fee: Either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee: 3% fee on the amounts transferred within the first 15 months; 5% on the amount of each transferred balance that posts to your account at a Promotional APR that we may offer you. Annual Fee: $0.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not explicitly stated on the page.

base_rate.description: Earn 1% cash back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back redemption options may include a statement credit, a cash deposit into your bank account, gift cards, and payment for purchases. Rewards won't expire for the life of the account. Unlimited Cashback Match: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

signup_bonus.description: Unlimited Cashback Match: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match. No purchase minimums.

benefits.title: Unlimited Cashback Match
benefits.description: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: You're never responsible for unauthorized purchases on your Discover Card.

benefits.title: Free Social Security number alerts
benefits.description: Get an alert if we find your Social Security number on the dark web. Sign up to activate this free benefit.

benefits.title: Freeze your account
benefits.description: If you misplace your card, you can prevent new purchases and cash advances in seconds with the on/off switch on our mobile app and website.

benefits.title: FICO® Score and more
benefits.description: It's free and checking your score doesn't hurt your credit.

benefits.title: Real human customer service 24/7
benefits.description: You can talk to a real human on our customer service team any time.

benefits.title: Tap to pay
benefits.description: It's fast and easy to pay with your contactless Discover Card.

notes: Verified from official product page on 2026-07-24.
